limitations: This is discrete work consistency of K2 constant diagonal inertia, not independent physical validation.
Signed contact work records stabilization energy injection; closing the ledger does not validate the stabilization law.
Shared geometry, missing full coupled inertia and unverified reference conditions remain.
The original native 192 saved runs and their failures are not rerun or replaced.
